title: xslt action
description: Transforms an XML body with an XSLT 2.0/3.0 stylesheet (XSLT 1.0 stylesheets run too). The stylesheet is a DIL resource (xslt:ref:<name>) or a file. The headers of the message that are text, numbers or booleans are the values of the stylesheet's top-level xsl:param of the same name. xsl:include, xsl:import, document() and unparsed-text() are not available.

resource.title: Stylesheet
resource.description: The stylesheet: the content of the resource the URI refers to, from dil.core.resources

path.title: Stylesheet file
path.description: Path of a file holding the stylesheet, read when the flow is loaded; set it or the resource
